# Source:physId

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.5</span></div>

Get or set the physId of the source if it is a FrSky sensor.

```lua
local physId = source:physId([physId])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `physId` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

physId (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
source = system.getSource({name="GPS"})
source:physId(0x01)
print(source:name() .. " module:" .. source:module() .. " band:" .. source:band() .. " appId:" .. source:appId() .. " physId:" .. source:physId())
```
